name: Campus Confidential
source: Campus Confidential is an engaging adult-themed high-quality dating simulation game, presently in early development and entirely supported by our Patreon community. The story follows a young college guy starting his first year of college. He was a bit of a geek in high school, but plans to turn that all around at college. Luckily, he has one of his best friends, Lexi, staying in the same dorm as him.
translation: 《校园机密》（Campus Confidential）是一款引人入胜的高品质成人恋爱模拟游戏，目前正处于早期开发阶段，完全由我们的Patreon社区提供支持。故事讲述了一名步入大一新生活的年轻男大学生：高中时代的他多少有些书呆子气，如今打算在大学里彻底改头换面。幸运的是，他最要好的挚友之一莱克茜恰好与他住进了同一栋宿舍楼。
